name: Implement Single Step
description: Implements a single step from a development plan. Uses an agentic loop to read context files, write code, and verify it compiles. Receives exactly one step at a time via the for-each loop in the workflow.

inputs.description: JSON step object with id, action, target, description
Absolute path to the repository root

outputs.description: JSON object with stepId, action, target, linesWritten, verified, notes

outputValidation.retryMessage: SYSTEM ERROR: Your step-complete summary contains prose text, but it MUST be a raw JSON object. The summary field must start with '{' and end with '}'. It must contain stepId, action, target, linesWritten, verified, and notes. Call step-complete again with ONLY the JSON object as the summary value.
